rationale: The negative half, and the exact bug class the powershell lane hit: a file banner became the documentation of whichever declaration came first, because the scanner walked upward through blank lines. Attribution here is strictly the immediately preceding line, so a comment followed by a BLANK line documents nothing, and `forbidDocstring` on both keys is the only way to say so -- an expect-channel cannot assert absence.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
